laat_vaar.voor: swaar werk doen soos klip breek
laat_vaar.na: swaar werk doen, soos klip breek
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A comma before the examples stops 'swaar werk doen soos klip breek' being read as 'work as hard as breaking stone' and marks the examples clearly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The AWS 2017 does not require a comma before 'soos' introducing examples, the sentence reads clearly in context, and the lesson already writes 'dinge soos kragmaste' without one, so this is a lateral move that would make the lesson inconsistent.

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Vonnis om vir die res van jou lewe opgesluit te wees.
na_skrywer.na: 'n Vonnis dat jy vir die res van jou lewe opgesluit bly.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'n Vonnis om ... opgesluit te wees' follows English 'a sentence to be locked up'; 'n vonnis dat jy ... opgesluit bly' is the natural Afrikaans construction with the same meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: 'n Vonnis om vir die res van jou lewe opgesluit te wees' follows the English 'a sentence to be locked up' and reads slightly stiff in Afrikaans.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it, for every lesson that uses it at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: 'n Stelsel waarin alle volwasse burgers stem om hul regering te kies.
vlae.rede: Read literally, this says every adult citizen actually votes; 'mag stem' (may vote) would be more exact, but that is a content choice, so it is flagged rather than changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Van sy 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Van Mandela se 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The block opens under a new heading with a bare 'sy', so the referent is named once for a reader who starts here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'sy' can only refer to Mandela, who is the subject of the block just before it, and the next block opens with a bare 'hy' too, so naming him here alone is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A bare '18' after 'mense van' reads incomplete; 'jaar' makes clear it is an age.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'mense van 18 en ouer' is ordinary, clear Afrikaans for an age in a voting sentence, so adding 'jaar' only reads differently.
